baseline.built_by: rl/ai_judge/build_baseline.sh (git archive HEAD engine, pgd_patch.py, cargo build --release --locked --offline --example pg_pos, 2 jobs)
baseline.printer: Name#<all arguments as compact JSON, keys sorted, Energy lists sorted> for every action without a short name (ChooseRetreatEnergy has none since frozen-4); same rule as plans/src/main.rs
baseline.reproduced: a second build from scratch with rl/ai_judge/build_baseline.sh gave the identical sha256

note: prompt v1 text and every frozen setting unchanged from frozen-2 and frozen-3 (same fingerprint). New since frozen-3: plan numbers are checked against the current plan list (identity hash, key, replay, prompt and reply re-derivation), the explicit eligibility selection with filtered references, prefix / full-plan / diagnostic reporting, the game-clustered analysis (analysis.py), strict row identity and flags, report provenance, compare checks the code fingerprint and the sources. Judge rows now record max_tokens and temperature; a missing REASON line is parse_warning. The plan lister and the baseline (pg_pos) were REBUILT: ChooseRetreatEnergy takes the Name#JSON label (it dropped the Energy paid), Energy lists are sorted in canonical labels, and replay prunes a dead alternative instead of abandoning the list.
